name: overflow
title: Overflow, boundaries, and division by zero
measures: MAX + 1, MIN - 1, MAX * 2, -MIN, MAX + MAX, overflow in an intermediate whose final result fits, fixed-width boundaries, and integer division by zero (C02, C03, C06, C08).
notes: Intended divergence (expected/test.ts.out): RuneScript checks every integer result and throws RangeError when a stored value does not fit; TypeScript numbers are doubles, so the same expressions give exact larger values (or Infinity for division by zero) and never fail. Where RuneScript prints an error, TypeScript prints a number.
